q: Which organ in the human body produces insulin?
exp: The pancreas produces insulin (from the islets of Langerhans). Answer: Pancreas

q: The powerhouse of the cell is?
exp: Mitochondria are called the powerhouse of the cell as they produce ATP energy. Answer: Mitochondria

q: How many bones are there in an adult human body?
exp: An adult human body has 206 bones. Answer: 206

q: Which blood group is called the universal donor?
exp: Blood group O negative is called the universal donor group. Answer: O

q: Photosynthesis primarily takes place in which part of the plant cell?
exp: Photosynthesis occurs in chloroplasts, which contain chlorophyll. Answer: Chloroplast

q: Deficiency of haemoglobin in blood causes which disease?
exp: Low haemoglobin causes anaemia. Answer: Anaemia

q: The largest gland in the human body is?
exp: The liver is the largest gland (and largest internal organ) in the human body. Answer: Liver

q: Which vitamin is produced in the human body on exposure to sunlight?
exp: Vitamin D is synthesised in the skin on exposure to sunlight (UVB rays). Answer: Vitamin D

q: The normal human body temperature is approximately?
exp: Normal human body temperature is about 37°C (98.6°F). Answer: 37°C

q: Which part of the brain controls balance and coordination?
exp: The cerebellum controls balance, posture and coordination of movements. Answer: Cerebellum

q: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called?
exp: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from aerial parts of plants (mainly leaves). Answer: Transpiration

q: Which disease is caused by the bite of a female Anopheles mosquito?
exp: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. Answer: Malaria

q: The functional unit of the kidney is called?
exp: The nephron is the structural and functional unit of the kidney. Answer: Nephron

q: Insulin was first isolated by which scientists?
exp: Frederick Banting and Charles Best isolated insulin in 1921. Answer: Banting and Best

q: The study of fungi is called?
exp: Mycology is the branch of biology that studies fungi. Answer: Mycology
